change: One POSIX pipe-barrier regression starts an actual second Python process before checkpoint transaction commit, observes its BEGIN IMMEDIATE request, then commits capture and checks schema 3, original checkpoint and paused/unknown current profile after reopen.

limitations: Synthetic temporary ledgers and a local Python subprocess only; no timing, scheduler fairness, throughput, live connection or recovery reliability claim.

observed_gap: Existing schema-upgrade regressions controlled same-process interleavings; no separate-process opener during uncommitted capture was covered. The production lock fix already exists.
